subject: Infosys Campus Drive 2027 batch - Registration Mandatory
body:
Dear Students,

Infosys is visiting campus for the 2027 batch (Specialist Programmer & Systems Engineer roles).

Eligibility: CGPA >= 7.0, no live KTs.

All interested students must register using the form below on or before 18/10/2026, 6:00 PM. Late registrations will NOT be accepted.

Registration form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd8kInfosysDrive2027RegXyZ/viewform

The online aptitude test will be held on 22nd October at 10:00 AM in the Main Auditorium. Carry your college ID.

Regards,
T&P Cell

subject: Circular: Semester V Examination Fee
body:
This is to inform all TY students that the Semester V examination fee of Rs. 1,500 must be paid through the ERP portal. Last date: 21-10-2026. A late fee of Rs. 500 per day will be charged thereafter.

[Attachment: Exam_fee_circular.pdf]
Examination fee circular. Students with pending dues will not receive hall tickets.
